title: Microsoft Entra PowerShell Administration
scenario: NewVue Health administrators are preparing a management workstation for Microsoft Entra administration by using PowerShell. Before the workstation can be used for cloud identity tasks, the correct PowerShell version must be available, the required module must be installed, and the administrator must authenticate successfully. Because this is a complementary activity, use the case study and reference information below to complete the required tasks.

activities.title: Task 1 - Prepare the Workstation
activities.prompt:
Drag and Drop Task
You want to prepare the workstation for Microsoft Entra administration.
To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
steps: Verify that the module is available
answer: Verify that the module is available
activities.explanation: Workstation preparation requires shell installation, verification, module installation, module validation, and connection.

activities.title: Task 2 - Install the Required Module
activities.prompt:
PowerShell Task
You want to install the module required for Microsoft Entra administration.
To answer, select the appropriate value for the missing portion of the command.
activities.explanation: The Microsoft.Entra module is required for this administration workflow.

activities.title: Task 3 - Choose the Correct Execution Policy
activities.prompt:
Dropdown Task
You want locally created scripts to run while downloaded scripts remain subject to appropriate trust controls.
To answer, select the execution policy that best supports that objective.
activities.explanation: RemoteSigned permits local scripts while applying restrictions to downloaded scripts.

activities.title: Task 4 - Connect to Microsoft Graph
activities.prompt:
PowerShell Task
You want to authenticate before running Microsoft Graph administrative commands.
To answer, select the appropriate value for the missing portion of the command.

activities.title: Task 5 - Interpret Common Commands
activities.prompt:
Matching Task
You want to interpret administrative PowerShell commands correctly.
To answer, match each command on the left with the task it performs on the right.
activities.explanation: Effective PowerShell administration requires correctly interpreting what each command does.

activities.title: Task 6 - Complete a User Creation Command
activities.prompt:
PowerShell Task
You want to define the sign-in identity for a new cloud user.
To answer, select the appropriate value for the missing portion of the command.
activities.explanation: The UserPrincipalName parameter defines the sign-in identity of the cloud user.

activities.title: Task 7 - Complete a Multi-Line Script
activities.prompt:
PowerShell Task
You want to connect to Microsoft Graph and create a new Microsoft Entra user.
To answer, select the appropriate value for each blank in the script.
activities.explanation: The workflow requires both the Graph connection and the correct user-creation parameters.
